svg.title: Where each lesson can be enforced
svg.desc: Four enforcement layers from a prompt to governance, with the lessons each can carry.
svg.text: A prompt is the shallowest layer: where each lesson can be enforced
33 of 58 lessons can be carried in context. The rest need code, architecture or people. A lesson may appear in more than one layer; this placement is the lab's
